instruction: I prefer VLC's minimal interface without the menu bar. How can I enable the minimal view mode in VLC to get a cleaner, distraction-free interface?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to enable VLC's minimal view mode (qt-minimal-view=1). The evaluator checks the vlcrc config file for the 'qt-minimal-view' setting and verifies it is set to 1 (enabled). Using existing metric function check_qt_minimal_view from vlc.py.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing check_qt_minimal_view metric which checks the qt-minimal-view setting in VLC config file (default is 0, task requires setting to 1)
